top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic HalvVättern's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
HalvVättern's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Road-specific control matters at HalvVättern. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 93 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of HalvVättern. Train it until it feels boring.
At HalvVättern, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what HalvVättern's mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at HalvVättern. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 93 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.weather: June in Motala, Sweden. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before HalvVättern. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for HalvVättern’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Durability, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 93 miles of mixed terrain in Motala, Sweden.
